python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import os
home = Path.home()
print(f'HOME={home}')
# Known mail client/data locations on Linux/current profile. Directory checks only.
checks = [
    ('Thunderbird', home/'.thunderbird'),
    ('Thunderbird (snap)', home/'snap/thunderbird/common/.thunderbird'),
    ('Mozilla Thunderbird (Flatpak)', home/'.var/app/org.mozilla.Thunderbird'),
    ('Evolution', home/'.local/share/evolution'),
    ('Evolution config/cache', home/'.config/evolution'),
    ('KMail / Akonadi local mail', home/'.local/share/local-mail'),
    ('KMail / Akonadi', home/'.local/share/akonadi'),
    ('KMail config', home/'.config/akonadi'),
    ('Geary', home/'.local/share/geary'),
    ('Geary config', home/'.config/geary'),
    ('Claws Mail', home/'.claws-mail'),
    ('Claws Mail config', home/'.config/claws-mail'),
    ('Sylpheed', home/'.sylpheed-2.0'),
    ('Mailspring', home/'.config/Mailspring'),
    ('Mailspring data', home/'.local/share/Mailspring'),
    ('MailSpring snap', home/'snap/mailspring'),
    ('Betterbird', home/'.betterbird'),
    ('SeaMonkey mail', home/'.mozilla/seamonkey'),
    ('Alpine/Pine mail', home/'mail'),
    ('Maildir', home/'Maildir'),
    ('mbox spool-ish', home/'mbox'),
    ('OfflineIMAP', home/'.offlineimap'),
    ('mbsync/isync', home/'.mbsyncrc'),
    ('notmuch', home/'.notmuch'),
    ('mu', home/'.cache/mu'),
]
found=[]
for name,p in checks:
    try:
        if p.exists():
            typ = 'dir' if p.is_dir() else 'file'
            found.append((name, typ, str(p)))
    except PermissionError:
        found.append((name, 'permission-denied', str(p)))
print('FOUND_COUNT='+str(len(found)))
for name,typ,path in found:
    print(f'{typ}\t{name}\t{path}')
